fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (33.135284,-91.968356, geocode movedMeters 3) landed at the south edge of the mill complex near the active warehouse/drop yard. Mill core re-centered to 33.1395,-91.9725. Address 100 Georgia-Pacific Dr, Crossett AR confirmed.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully fenced — continuous chain-link perimeter fence clearly visible in Street View (Oct 2024) along the south side. The warehouse drop yard is entered via a driveway that crosses the rail line into the fenced yard with a checkpoint structure; large GP mill is controlled-access.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small structure observed at the warehouse-yard gate driveway; consistent with a guard booth but resolution at z20 too low to confirm definitively. Inferred from facility scale.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-section campus: pulp mill, paper machines, tissue/converting, finished-goods warehouse, power/recovery, and a former chemical-plant section. Parts of the historic east complex appear decommissioned (cleared concrete pads).
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spurs run through the property; rail line and tank cars visible along the south boundary and east section.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large multi-row drop yard adjacent to the finished-goods warehouse — well over 100 trailers in clearly marked rows.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive dock-door banks along the warehouse south/east faces with trailers backed in; ~45 estimated, low confidence due to building scale.
fieldNotes.scale: Truck scale expected at a mill of this scale handling inbound chips and outbound finished goods; not definitively resolved overhead.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound chips/raw material handled on the north; finished tissue/paper ships from the SW warehouse docks — physically separate.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least one main warehouse gate; the large campus likely has a separate main mill/personnel gate — counted 2 as estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons at the drop yard and warehouse driveway offer ample unused width for a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Crossett is a small mill town built around this facility; open country and forest beyond. Rural.

citations.claim: GP $90M + 50 jobs to grow consumer tissue at Crossett (Angel Soft); 400+ employees; production 2026

verification.rationale: GP idled the Crossett pulp/bleached-board lines in 2019 but the consumer tissue/towel operation remains GP-operated with fresh 2024 capex. Model as tissue-only, not full pulp/paper/tissue complex.
